description: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for different methods with respect to the number of steps. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 15000000 with a tick label interval of 5000000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and has a linear scale, ranging from 3.0 to 3.4 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The plot contains four lines: a blue solid line representing "Vanilla", a red dashed line representing "StrmLLM (n=64)", a green dashed line representing "SepLLM (n=64)", and two other dashed lines representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)" and "SepLLM (n=128)" in orange and purple, respectively. The "Vanilla" line starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 3.1. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" line begins at about 3.3 and declines to roughly 3.1. The "SepLLM (n=64)" line starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 3.15. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line begins at about 3.3 and declines to roughly 3.1. The "SepLLM (n=128)" line starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 3.15. All lines exhibit a downward trend across the x-axis.
